_comment: Config for Module A01 (Idea/Concept) of the ASMR Papercut shorts brand. recurring_tools are ALWAYS reused across every video (the Asset Manager pins them, the model never reinvents them) — this is what makes the tools look identical every time. The model only invents the SUBJECT prop(s) + beats. subject_pool seeds variety; avoid_recent dedupes against output/asmr/ideas/used.json.

recurring_tools.name: Paper Hands
recurring_tools.visual_description: A gentle pair of cut-paper hands made of warm peach cardstock, with softly rounded fingers, subtle layered-paper knuckle creases, and clean matte knife-cut edges; they move slowly and calmly.

recurring_tools.name: Craft Knife
recurring_tools.visual_description: A small papercraft craft knife with a flat cut-paper silver blade and a pastel mint-green handle, crisp clean paper edges and a soft drop shadow.

recurring_tools.name: Cutting Board
recurring_tools.visual_description: A rounded rectangular cutting board built from layered kraft-paper woodgrain in warm honey-tan, with soft paper edge highlights and a gentle shadow beneath.
